scope: Theorem 6.8 (Relaxed energy) of the manuscript “Functional universality of critical SK autocorrelations” (preprints/Functional-universality-of-critical-SK-autocorrelations-October-5-2026/critical-sk-autocorrelations.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f38734b35e639f88), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 48. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The constant c∗ = ω({0}) is deterministic and strictly positive. On any quenched represented subsequence, suppose that ∥fn∥∞ ≤ CnD for fixed C, D, that the L2 norms and TE(fn) are bounded, and that fn converges weakly against cylinders to F. Then F is in the closed form domain on L2(Π) and lim inf n→∞ TE(fn) ≥ c∗Π[∥∇F∥2 ℓ2 ]. (6.23) Conversely, for each smooth compact cylinder F, the functions fn,Qj in (6.22) converge strongly to F for every fixed j, are polynomially bounded at that fixed j, and satisfy lim j→∞ lim n→∞ TE(fn,Qj ) = c∗Π[∥∇F∥2 ]. All assertions for countably many chosen sources and tests hold on a common represented event. In particular the lower bound and recovery use the same deterministic coefficient.
